notes.title: The Tavern Tales: Medieval Simulator — Early Access Release on Steam
notes.notes:
On September 1, 2025, we are proud to announce the official Early Access release of The Tavern Tales: Medieval Simulator on Steam. Over the past months, our team at Flash Ray Games has worked tirelessly to create an immersive and authentic medieval tavern experience — and now it’s finally time to open the doors!

In The Tavern Tales, you will:

Run your own tavern — cook meals, serve drinks, and take care of every guest who steps through your door.

Upgrade and decorate — furnish your place, add atmosphere, and make your tavern the most popular in town.

Grow your garden — cultivate crops to use in recipes or sell for extra income.

Send out expeditions — gather exotic resources, unlock new recipes, and bring back unique souvenirs from dangerous journeys.

Interact with special guests — handle them wisely, as their influence may bring fortune… or trouble.

Stay tuned to the town’s news — city events and notices can change the course of your tavern’s story.

Early Access is not just about releasing the game early — it’s about building it together with you. We want The Tavern Tales to grow based on community feedback, player suggestions, and shared passion for cozy medieval life simulations.

Mark your calendars: September 1, 2025. Add the game to your wishlist, join us on this journey, and help us shape the future of The Tavern Tales.

Prepare your pan, sharpen your axe, and invite your friends — the tavern opens soon, and your story begins!
